title: PCI DSS v4.0 — Cernus runtime crosswalk
description: PCI DSS requirements Cernus can evidence from runtime facts for in-scope system components. Supporting evidence only; scoping and assessment remain the QSA's.

controls.title: Configuration Standards Applied
controls.statement: System components are configured per hardening standards. Checked: no open misconfiguration findings.

controls.title: Software Engineering Prevents Common Attacks
controls.statement: Bespoke software is reviewed for common attack classes. Checked: the latest deployment passed the SAST gate.

controls.title: Security Vulnerabilities Identified and Managed
controls.statement: New vulnerabilities are identified on a defined cadence. Checked: latest scan within the freshness window.

controls.title: Inventory of Bespoke and Third-Party Software
controls.statement: An inventory of software components is maintained. Checked: deployed images carry stored SBOMs.

controls.title: Known Vulnerabilities Patched in Timeframes
controls.statement: Critical fixes within one month, others per risk ranking. Checked: no finding past its remediation window.

controls.title: Changes Follow Change Control
controls.statement: Production changes are documented and approved. Checked: the latest deployment has a change id and passed delivery gates.

controls.title: No Hardcoded Authentication Factors
controls.statement: Passwords and keys are not hardcoded in code or config. Checked: no open embedded-secret findings.

controls.title: Internal Vulnerability Scans Performed
controls.statement: Internal scans run at least quarterly and after changes. Checked: automated rescans exist for this system.
